title: FastCI: Efficient GPU-Intensive CI for LLM Training Frameworks
title_zh: FastCI：面向大语言模型训练框架的高效GPU密集型持续集成

paragraphs.en: As large language models (LLMs) keep growing in size and complexity, their training frameworks evolve at a rapid pace as well. Therefore, continuous integration (CI) is critical for maintaining the quality and stability of these frameworks. However, unlike traditional software, CI for LLM training frameworks relies on GPU-intensive tests, which usually involve complete model training or evaluation. This leads CI itself to become a new bottleneck for fast-paced development. In this paper, we introduce FastCI, a framework that improves the efficiency of CI for LLM training frameworks. FastCI leverages runtime evidence to select affected tests and prune tests that execute changed code in equivalent contexts. Then FastCI prioritizes high-risk tests to expose potential failures earlier, and optimizes test workloads along dimensions outside the intended validation scope of each test. Evaluated on the CI workload of our LLM training framework, FastCI reduces the CI latency by 77.5% and the GPU resource usage by 63.9%, while improving the modified code coverage retention by 3.2%, compared with the currently deployed CI pipelines. FastCI has now been integrated into the CI pipelines of our LLM training framework at ByteDance.

paragraphs.en: As large language models (LLMs) keep growing in size and complexity and are adopted in a wider range of tasks ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ; Brown et al., 2020 ; Hoffmann et al., 2022 ) , their training frameworks have evolved from simple libraries to sophisticated systems. For example, training frameworks may combine data, tensor, and pipeline parallelism with partitioned optimizer states in large scale training, or jointly manage vision and language components in multimodal training ( Narayanan et al., 2021 ; Rajbhandari et al., 2020 ; Alayrac et al., 2022 ; Liu et al., 2023a ) . To preserve the quality and stability of these frameworks, continuous integration (CI) has become a critical part of the development process. CI refers to continuously building and testing code changes, commonly when a merge request (MR) is submitted or updated. Unlike traditional software, whose CI workloads are typically dominated by unit tests, LLM training frameworks rely heavily on GPU-intensive end-to-end tests, since many behaviors, including successful training completion and numerical alignment, can be verified only through complete model training or evaluation. Validating these behaviors requires an extensive test suite that takes hours and consumes substantial GPU resources, making CI a new bottleneck in fast-paced LLM framework development.
paragraphs.zh: 随着大型语言模型（LLM）的规模和复杂性持续增长，并被应用于更广泛的任务（Vaswani 等，2017；Brown 等，2020；Hoffmann 等，2022），其训练框架已从简单的库演变为复杂的系统。 例如，在大规模训练中，训练框架可能会结合数据、张量和管道并行性，以及分区的优化器状态；或在多模态训练中联合管理视觉和语言组件（Narayanan 等，2021；Rajbhandari 等，2020；Alayrac 等，2022；Liu 等，2023a）。 为了保持这些框架的质量和稳定性，持续集成（CI）已成为开发流程中的关键部分。 CI 指持续构建和测试代码变更，通常在提交或更新合并请求（MR）时执行。 与传统软件不同，后者的 CI 工作负载通常以单元测试为主，而 LLM 训练框架则严重依赖 GPU 密集型端到端测试，因为许多行为——包括训练成功完成和数值对齐——只能通过完整的模型训练或评估来验证。 验证这些行为需要一个庞大的测试套件，该套件需要数小时时间并消耗大量 GPU 资源，这使得 CI 成为快速迭代的 LLM 框架开发中的新瓶颈。

paragraphs.en: In production CI pipelines, long latency and high GPU resource consumption are even more severe ( Hilton et al., 2016 ; Xiao et al., 2018 ; Gu et al., 2019 ; Memon et al., 2017 ) . The master branch of our training framework receives more than 200 MRs per week, and each MR may trigger CI pipelines multiple times as developers push commits to refine code or fix failures. Coding agents have further increased the frequency of code changes, accelerating development while also adding to the CI burden ( Malhotra, 2026 ) . To handle this workload, we maintain a dedicated CI resource pool comprising thousands of GPUs. Nevertheless, this resource pool remains saturated, and a CI run takes more than four hours on average. This problem stems not only from the high cost of individual end-to-end tests, but also from inefficiencies in how existing CI pipelines validate the code changes. In fact, many tests are unnecessary, as they do not cover the changed code.
paragraphs.zh: 在生产CI流水线中，长延迟和高GPU资源消耗问题甚至更为严重（Hilton等，2016；Xiao等，2018；Gu等，2019；Memon等，2017）。 我们的训练框架的主分支每周接收超过200个MR，而每个MR可能会因开发者提交代码以完善代码或修复故障而多次触发CI流水线。 编码智能体进一步增加了代码变更的频率，在加速开发的同时也加重了CI的负担（Malhotra，2026）。 为了应对这一工作负载，我们维护了一个由数千个GPU组成的专用CI资源池。 然而，该资源池仍然处于饱和状态，一次CI运行平均需要超过四个小时。 这个问题不仅源于单个端到端测试的高成本，也源于现有CI流水线在验证代码变更时的低效性。 事实上，许多测试都是不必要的，因为它们并未覆盖到已变更的代码。

paragraphs.en: To prevent CI from triggering full test suites for each MR, path-based test selection has been adopted in open source projects and industry practice ( Luu, 2026 ; Ray Project, 2026 ) . This approach selects tests based on the mapping from files to tests, which is built and maintained manually in our deployed CI pipelines. There are two limitations preventing this approach from addressing the CI bottleneck for LLM training frameworks effectively. First, the mapping from files to tests is too coarse-grained to capture the dependencies between code changes and tests precisely, still causing many unnecessary tests to be executed. Second, maintaining the mapping manually is error-prone as the codebase evolves rapidly, and incomplete mappings can lead to false negatives in test selection. Figure 1 illustrates over-selection by path-based test selection. In this example, an MR modifies the function parallelize_vision within vision_encoder_parallel.py . Path-based test selection includes all tests that depend on the modified file, while runtime evidence shows that only the Multimodal Training Test executes the modified function. This suggests that precise test selection should move from static file-level path mapping to function-level runtime evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 为防止 CI 在每次合并请求（MR）中触发完整的测试套件，开源项目和行业实践已采用基于路径的测试选择方法（Luu, 2026；Ray Project, 2026）。 该方法根据文件到测试的映射关系来选择测试，而这一映射关系在我们的已部署 CI 流水线中是手动构建和维护的。 存在两个局限性，导致该方法无法有效解决 LLM 训练框架中的 CI 瓶颈问题。 首先，文件到测试的映射过于粗略，无法精确捕捉代码变更与测试之间的依赖关系，因此仍会导致许多不必要的测试被执行。 其次，随着代码库的快速演进，手动维护这种映射容易出错，而不完整的映射可能导致测试选择出现假阴性结果。 图 1 展示了基于路径的测试选择方法导致的过度选择问题。 在此示例中，一个合并请求（MR）修改了 vision_encoder_parallel.py 文件中的 parallelize_vision 函数。 基于路径的测试选择方法会包含所有依赖该修改文件的测试，而运行时证据表明，只有“多模态训练测试”实际执行了被修改的函数。 这表明，精确的测试选择应从静态的文件级路径映射转向基于函数级的运行时证据。

paragraphs.en: Beyond test selection, how the selected tests are executed presents further optimization opportunities ( Li et al., 2024 ; Dutta et al., 2021 ) . In our CI pipelines, tests follow first-in-first-out scheduling, which may take a long time to expose CI failures. Exposing failures earlier allows developers to manually stop the CI run and fix them sooner, saving time and GPU resources. In addition, end-to-end tests usually reuse the same workloads whose model sizes and numbers of training steps exceed what is necessary for their intended validation scope. These inefficiencies further delay actionable feedback and consume GPU resources without proportionally improving regression validation.
paragraphs.zh: 除了测试选择之外，所选测试的执行方式也提供了进一步的优化机会（Li et al., 2024；Dutta et al., 2021）。 在我们的 CI 流水线中，测试遵循先进先出调度策略，这可能导致需要很长时间才能暴露 CI 故障。 更早地暴露故障能让开发者手动停止 CI 运行并更快地修复问题，从而节省时间和 GPU 资源。 此外，端到端测试通常会重复使用相同的工作负载，而这些工作负载的模型大小和训练步数超出了其预期验证范围所需的最小值。 这些低效之处进一步延迟了可操作的反馈，并消耗了 GPU 资源，却未能相应地提升回归验证效果。

paragraphs.en: To address these issues, we present FastCI, a framework that optimizes both test selection and test execution in CI pipelines for LLM training frameworks. For test selection, FastCI uses lightweight sampling to collect runtime traces from GPU-intensive tests and organizes them into a graph that records the functions and calls observed for each test. Using this runtime evidence graph, FastCI selects only the tests that execute the changed functions and prunes those that execute them in equivalent contexts. For test execution, FastCI schedules tests based on their execution history, prioritizing high-risk tests to expose potential failures earlier, and accelerates individual tests by reducing the workload along dimensions outside the intended validation scope of each test.
paragraphs.zh: 为解决这些问题，我们提出了 FastCI——一个能够同时优化 LLM 训练框架中 CI 管道内测试选择和测试执行的框架。 在测试选择方面，FastCI 采用轻量级采样方法，从 GPU 密集型测试中收集运行时轨迹，并将其组织成一张记录每个测试所观察到的函数和调用的图。 FastCI 利用这张运行时证据图，仅选择执行了变更函数的测试，并剔除那些在等效上下文中执行这些函数的测试。 在测试执行方面，FastCI 根据测试的执行历史进行调度，优先安排高风险测试以尽早暴露潜在故障，并通过减少每个测试预期验证范围之外的维度上的工作量来加速单个测试的执行。

sents.en: To address these issues, we present FastCI, a framework that optimizes both test selection and test execution in CI pipelines for LLM training frameworks.

sents.en: For test selection, FastCI uses lightweight sampling to collect runtime traces from GPU-intensive tests and organizes them into a graph that records the functions and calls observed for each test.

sents.en: Using this runtime evidence graph, FastCI selects only the tests that execute the changed functions and prunes those that execute them in equivalent contexts.
sents.zh: FastCI 利用这张运行时证据图，仅选择执行了变更函数的测试，并剔除那些在等效上下文中执行这些函数的测试。

sents.en: For test execution, FastCI schedules tests based on their execution history, prioritizing high-risk tests to expose potential failures earlier, and accelerates individual tests by reducing the workload along dimensions outside the intended validation scope of each test.
sents.zh: 在测试执行方面，FastCI 根据测试的执行历史进行调度，优先安排高风险测试以尽早暴露潜在故障，并通过减少每个测试预期验证范围之外的维度上的工作量来加速单个测试的执行。

paragraphs.en: Evaluated on the CI workload of our LLM training framework, FastCI reduces the CI latency by 77.5% and the GPU resource usage by 63.9% compared with path-based test selection, which is currently adopted in our CI pipelines. Furthermore, FastCI cuts the GPU resource usage before exposing the first failure by 89.2%, compared with the currently used first-in-first-out test scheduling. FastCI has now been integrated into the CI pipelines of our LLM training framework at ByteDance. With FastCI handling the CI workload, the average CI latency has been reduced by 58.4%, substantially improving development efficiency of our LLM training framework.

paragraphs.en: Program analysis and runtime tracing for test selection. Regression test selection usually relies on dependencies between code and tests to identify which tests are affected by code changes ( Rothermel & Harrold, 1996 ; Yoo & Harman, 2012 ; Elbaum et al., 2014 ) . In addition to manually maintained path mapping, static program analysis is also widely used to extract these dependencies ( Legunsen et al., 2017 ; Zhang, 2018 ; Liu et al., 2023b ; Zhang et al., 2024 ; Maurina et al., 2025 ) . File- or module-level static analysis is coarse-grained and still over-selects tests ( Shi et al., 2017 ) . Function- or method-level analysis can be more precise but introduce high analysis overhead for LLM training frameworks, causing the analysis to time out in our experiments. To address this issue, some recent approaches optimize the static analysis process. NameRTS makes function-level analysis potentially practical by using conservative name matching refined with runtime information ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . However, end-to-end tests in LLM training frameworks often share a core training entry point but execute different code paths across configurations, tasks, and enabled features. As NameRTS distinguishes tests by their test file entry points, it may therefore select unnecessary jobs in this scenario, as evaluated in Section 5.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 通过程序分析和运行时追踪来选择测试用例。 回归测试的选择通常依赖代码与测试之间的依赖关系，以识别哪些测试会受到代码更改的影响（Rothermel & Harrold, 1996；Yoo & Harman, 2012；Elbaum et al., 2014）。 除了手动维护的路径映射外，静态程序分析也被广泛用于提取这些依赖关系（Legunsen et al., 2017；Zhang, 2018；Liu et al., 2023b；Zhang et al., 2024；Maurina et al., 2025）。 文件或模块级别的静态分析粒度较粗，仍然会导致测试用例选择过多（Shi et al., 2017）。 函数或方法级别的分析可能更精确，但会为 LLM 训练框架带来高昂的分析开销，导致我们的实验中分析过程超时。 为解决这一问题，一些近期的方法对静态分析过程进行了优化。 NameRTS 通过结合运行时信息对保守的名称匹配进行细化，使函数级别的分析具有实际可行性（Wang et al., 2026）。 然而，LLM 训练框架中的端到端测试通常共享一个核心的训练入口点，但会在不同配置、任务和启用功能中执行不同的代码路径。 由于 NameRTS 通过测试文件的入口点来区分测试用例，因此在这种场景下它可能会选择不必要的任务，这一点已在第 5.2 节中进行了评估。

paragraphs.en: Prediction-based test selection and prioritization. Prediction-based approaches may leverage historical outcomes, developer-provided information, learned representations, or LLM reasoning ( Roy et al., 2026 ; Tao et al., 2025 ) to identify tests that are likely to fail ( Leong et al., 2019 ; Machalica et al., 2019 ; Spieker et al., 2017 ; Prado Lima & Vergilio, 2022 ; Pan et al., 2022 ; Zhao et al., 2023 ; Plyusnin et al., 2025 ; Mehta et al., 2021 ; Herzig et al., 2015 ) . However, their predictions do not provide a clear guarantee for test skipping. They are therefore commonly used in fail-stop pipelines, where likely failures are executed first but the full test suite remains necessary if no failure is observed. Rather than using predictions to skip tests, FastCI uses historical information only to schedule selected tests in our non-fail-stop CI pipelines.
paragraphs.zh: 基于预测的测试选择与优先级排序。 基于预测的方法可以利用历史结果、开发者提供的信息、学习到的表示或大型语言模型（LLM）的推理（Roy 等，2026；Tao 等，2025），以识别可能失败的测试（Leong 等，2019；Machalica 等，2019；Spieker 等，2017；Prado Lima 与 Vergilio，2022；Pan 等，2022；Zhao 等，2023；Plyusnin 等，2025；Mehta 等，2021；Herzig 等，2015）。 然而，这些预测并未为跳过测试提供明确的保证。 因此，它们通常被用于“失败即停止”的流程中：可能失败的测试会被优先执行，但如果未观察到任何失败，完整的测试套件仍然必须运行。 FastCI 并未使用预测来跳过测试，而是仅利用历史信息，在我们的非“失败即停止”的持续集成（CI）流程中安排已选测试的执行顺序。

paragraphs.en: Figure 2 provides an overview of FastCI. FastCI consists of modular components that can be integrated into existing CI pipelines for LLM training frameworks with minimal changes. Across CI runs, it continuously updates a runtime evidence graph and test execution history. For each MR, FastCI uses this state to optimize both test selection and execution, improving CI efficiency throughout the MR lifecycle.

paragraphs.en: Each CI run first enters test selection. FastCI applies evidence-guided test selection , mapping code changes to runtime graph entities and selecting tests that reach them. If some changes lack corresponding entities, indicating incomplete runtime evidence, FastCI broadens the selection to reduce the risk of omitting affected tests. The selected tests then pass through context-aware test pruning , which identifies tests that execute the changed code in equivalent contexts and removes redundant ones from the selection. In this phase, the core of FastCI is a runtime evidence graph built from runtime-sampled traces. This graph must be updated continuously to reflect the evolving codebase, which we will detail in Section 4.1 .

paragraphs.en: The remaining tests then enter the test execution phase. FastCI first applies risk-aware test scheduling to prioritize high-risk tests based on associations between code changes and test failures, together with the recent flakiness of each test. This scheduling exposes potential failures earlier, allowing developers to receive feedback and intervene sooner. Then the ordered tests are submitted for execution, where FastCI applies workload-optimized test execution to reduce workload along dimensions outside the intended validation scope of each test. If the workload cannot be reduced, FastCI retains the original workload to preserve the validation capability of the test.

paragraphs.en: This section details the design of FastCI, consisting of four techniques, which are evidence-guided test selection (Section 4.1 ), context-aware test pruning (Section 4.2 ), risk-aware test scheduling (Section 4.3 ), and workload-optimized test execution (Section 4.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 本节详细阐述了 FastCI 的设计，它由四种技术组成：证据引导的测试选择（第 4.1 节）、上下文感知的测试剪枝（第 4.2 节）、风险感知的测试调度（第 4.3 节）以及工作负载优化的测试执行（第 4.4 节）。

paragraphs.en: Evidence-guided test selection uses a runtime evidence graph built from runtime traces sampled during previous CI runs. When the graph contains evidence for a modified function, FastCI directly selects the tests observed to execute that function. When such evidence is missing, FastCI intentionally broadens the selection to include tests that may execute the modified function even though this execution was not observed in previous runs.
paragraphs.zh: 基于证据的测试选择方法使用一个运行时证据图，该图由先前 CI 运行期间采样的运行时轨迹构建而成。 当图中包含对某个已修改函数的证据时，FastCI 会直接选择那些已知执行该函数的测试。 如果缺乏此类证据，FastCI 会故意扩大测试范围，将可能执行该已修改函数的测试也包含在内，即使这些测试在先前运行中未被观察到执行。

paragraphs.en: The remaining challenge is keeping the runtime evidence graph aligned with the evolving codebase. Sampling tools ( e.g. , py-spy ( Frederickson, 2026 ) ) add overhead, but it is small relative to savings of FastCI. By default, FastCI samples each CI run and updates the graph when an MR is merged. For a stable codebase, since a single MR changes only a small fraction of the codebase, the graph tolerates limited staleness and can instead be updated periodically, such as every three commits.
paragraphs.zh: 剩下的挑战是保持运行时证据图与不断演变的代码库同步。 采样工具（例如 py-spy (Frederickson, 2026)）会增加额外开销，但与 FastCI 带来的节省相比，这一开销很小。 默认情况下，FastCI 会对每次 CI 运行进行采样，并在 MR 合并时更新该图。 对于稳定的代码库而言，由于单个 MR 仅会修改代码库的一小部分，因此该图可以容忍有限的过时性，也可以改为定期更新，例如每三次提交更新一次。

paragraphs.en: After evidence-guided test selection, the selected test set may still be large because multiple tests can execute the same modified function ( Shi et al., 2015 ) . For instance, lightweight environment checking functions are invoked by most end-to-end tests, causing many tests with redundant coverage to be selected when these functions change. Although one representative test may be sufficient, tests cannot be pruned solely because they execute the same function, as the behavior of the function may depend on the calling context. FastCI therefore distinguishes tests by their execution contexts and prunes only those that exercise the modified function in equivalent contexts.
paragraphs.zh: 在基于证据的测试选择之后，所选的测试集可能仍然很大，因为多个测试可以执行相同的修改后函数（Shi et al., 2015）。 例如，大多数端到端测试都会调用轻量级环境检查函数，当这些函数发生变化时，会导致许多具有冗余覆盖率的测试被选中。 尽管一个代表性测试可能已经足够，但仅因为它们执行相同的函数而剪枝测试是不可行的，因为该函数的行为可能依赖于调用上下文。 因此，FastCI 通过其执行上下文来区分测试，并且只剪枝那些在等效上下文中执行修改后函数的测试。

paragraphs.en: After identifying redundant tests, FastCI selects a representative test for each equivalence group. It estimates the GPU cost of each test from its historical execution time and the number of GPUs required. Among tests with equivalent execution contexts and validation metadata, FastCI selects the test with the lowest estimated GPU cost, while the remaining tests are pruned from the selection.
paragraphs.zh: 在识别出冗余测试后，FastCI 会为每个等价组选择一个代表性测试。 它根据每个测试的历史执行时间和所需 GPU 数量来估算其 GPU 成本。 在执行上下文和验证元数据等价的测试中，FastCI 会选择估算 GPU 成本最低的测试，而其余测试则从候选集中被剔除。

paragraphs.en: Once the test set has been selected and pruned, the remaining tests are scheduled and dispatched to the GPU resource pool for execution. First-in-first-out scheduling can delay actionable failure feedback. Developers must then fix the problem and rerun CI from scratch, leading to inefficient development cycles and GPU resource waste. FastCI instead derives each test’s risk from historical execution outcomes and prioritizes high-risk tests to expose potential failures earlier.

paragraphs.en: Failures in production CI pipelines arise not only from incorrect code changes but also from external factors such as environment issues and dependency breakages. FastCI therefore uses two complementary risk indicators to prioritize tests. The first captures historical associations between code changes and test failures. It identifies failures likely caused by code changes but provides limited evidence for newly added modules and functions. The second captures the recent instability of each test. It reflects failures caused by changing environments, dependencies, or flaky behavior ( Luo et al., 2014 ; Bell et al., 2018 ; Lam et al., 2020 ) , but is less specific to the current code change.

paragraphs.en: Beyond test scheduling, FastCI also considers the workload of each test to optimize the GPU resource utilization. Typically, the workload of each test is derived from production configurations. paragraphs.zh: 除了测试调度之外，FastCI 还会考虑每个测试的工作负载，以优化 GPU 资源利用率。 通常，每个测试的工作负载都来自生产环境配置。 工作负载的某些维度（包括并行度与批量大小）会根据 CI 要求进行调整，但其他维度（如模型大小、序列长度以及生产选项（例如日志记录与指标收集））则保持不变。 这些未改变的工作负载维度会进一步增加 GPU 资源占用，却无法成比例地提升回归验证效果，因为它们超出了测试的预期验证范围。

paragraphs.zh: 在每次测试中，FastCI 会通过测试元数据和运行时证据图中的历史执行路径，识别出与预期验证范围相关的工作负载维度。 例如，分布式执行测试依赖于并行度，而长序列训练测试则依赖于序列长度。 对于能够明确识别为与预期验证范围无关的维度，FastCI 会自动将其缩减。 对于无法明确识别的维度，FastCI 会保持其不变。

paragraphs.en: FastCI applies these reductions as configuration overrides when submitting a test to the existing CI runner, without modifying the test code. In practice, we found that decreasing model size and turning off production options like logging and metrics collection can accelerate tests in many cases while producing the same test outcomes as the original workload in our comparisons. To reduce the risk of missing failures that appear only under the original workload, FastCI periodically executes the same test with both the original and reduced workloads and compares their pass or fail outcomes. The reduction is retained only while the outcomes agree. Otherwise, the original workload is restored. Repeating this comparison allows FastCI to withdraw an accepted reduction when the code or test behavior changes.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate FastCI on CI workloads from our LLM training framework, which supports diverse training tasks at ByteDance. Compared with deployed CI, FastCI reduces latency by 77.5% and GPU usage by 63.9%, while improving modified code coverage retention by 3.2% through recovering affected tests missed by file-level mappings. Each technique contributes to overall performance. FastCI has been integrated into production CI at ByteDance and now handles the CI workload, reducing CI latency by 58.4%, with no reported regressions caused by omitted tests across 784 CI runs over three weeks.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate the end-to-end performance of FastCI by sampling production MRs and submitting them to self-provisioned shadow CI pipelines over two days, avoiding interference with production CI. We compare FastCI against full CI, path-based CI, NameRTS, and FastCI-select. Under full CI, the entire suite is executed for each MR, while path-based CI uses the file-level mapping to select tests and is currently deployed in our production CI. NameRTS is a state-of-the-art regression test selection method whose optimized static analysis scales to our large LLM training framework ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . FastCI-select applies only evidence-guided selection and context-aware pruning, without risk-aware test scheduling or workload-optimized execution.

paragraphs.en: Figure 5 compares the average efficiency of different approaches. Path-based CI selects 50.6% of tests and reduces GPU resource usage, CI latency, and queueing time of tests to 51.5%, 26.9%, and 21.1% of full CI, respectively. However, its coarse-grained mappings still select many unnecessary tests, preventing it from fully relieving the pressure on production CI. Fine-grained static analysis alone is also insufficient as NameRTS selects 55.1% of tests and is even less efficient than path-based CI across all four metrics. This is because NameRTS is only able to map code changes to entry points of tests, which can be shared by the end-to-end tests of LLM training framework CI, causing over-selection. Beyond them, FastCI reduces GPU resource usage, CI latency, and queueing time to 18.6%, 6.1%, and 1.8% of full CI.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate test selection by replaying production CI workloads from an internal LLM training framework. We compare five test selection methods: path-based test selection, LLM reasoning, NameRTS, FastCI-select without context-aware test pruning, and the full FastCI-select. For the LLM reasoning baseline, a GPT-5.5 ( OpenAI, 2026 ) agent analyzes each MR diff and candidate tests and returns those it considers affected. For efficiency, we measure the selected-test ratio and normalized GPU cost. For coverage, we execute the full suite with exhaustive line-level collection using Coverage.py ( Batchelder et al., 2026 ) , establishing an offline reference of tests that execute the modified code. Against this reference, we measure the recall of affected tests and the modified code coverage retained by each selection method.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过重播内部 LLM 训练框架中的生产 CI 工作负载来评估测试选择方法。 我们比较了五种测试选择方法：基于路径的测试选择、LLM 推理、NameRTS、不带上下文感知测试剪枝的 FastCI-select，以及完整的 FastCI-select。 对于 LLM 推理基线方法，一个 GPT-5.5（OpenAI, 2026）智能体会分析每个 MR diff 和候选测试，并返回其认为受影响的测试。 为提升效率，我们测量了所选测试比例和归一化 GPU 成本。 在覆盖率方面，我们使用 Coverage.py（Batchelder et al., 2026）以详尽的行级收集方式执行完整测试套件，从而建立一个离线参考集，记录哪些测试执行了修改后的代码。 基于该参考集，我们测量了各测试选择方法在受影响测试的召回率以及保留的修改后代码覆盖率。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Table 1 , compared with path-based test selection, evidence-guided test selection achieves better efficiency by reducing the selected test ratio from 62.6% to 35.9% and normalized GPU cost from 67.6% to 39.4%, while improving the recall of affected tests from 76.1% to 84.5% and modified code coverage retention from 96.0% to 99.8%. By further applying context-aware test pruning, FastCI-select reduces the selected test ratio to 25.7% and normalized GPU cost to 28.6%. This efficiency gain comes with recall of affected tests decreasing to 66.2%, as some affected tests are intentionally pruned as redundant. However, modified code coverage retention decreases by only 0.6% to 99.2%, which remains higher than that of the other approaches, suggesting that most pruned tests cover modified code already executed by the retained tests.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate whether FastCI’s risk-aware scheduling exposes CI failures earlier, improving feedback efficiency and reducing GPU usage. We compare FastCI with the production first-in-first-out order, the two single-indicator variants, and COLEMAN, a representative learning-based test prioritization approach for CI ( Prado Lima & Vergilio, 2022 ) . We use its best-performing configuration, FRRMAB with the TimeRank reward, and average the results over ten fixed random seeds. Because resource pool capacity and concurrent CI workloads affect feedback latency, we focus on first-failing-test rank and GPU consumption before the first failure, which directly reflect the effectiveness of test scheduling.
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估 FastCI 的风险感知调度能否更早地暴露 CI 故障，从而提升反馈效率并减少 GPU 使用量。 我们将 FastCI 与生产环境中的先进先出顺序、两种单一指标变体，以及 COLEMAN（一种用于 CI 的学习型测试优先级排序方法，Prado Lima & Vergilio, 2022）进行了比较。 我们采用了其性能最佳的配置——结合 TimeRank 奖励的 FRRMAB，并对十个固定随机种子下的结果求平均值。 由于资源池容量和并发 CI 工作负载会影响反馈延迟，因此我们重点关注首次故障测试的排名以及首次故障发生前的 GPU 消耗量，这些指标直接反映了测试调度的有效性。

paragraphs.en: Figure 7 shows that, compared with production first-in-first-out scheduling, FastCI reduces median first-failure rank by 63.6% and median GPU consumption before the first failure by 89.2%, exposing failures earlier with substantially less GPU consumption. Compared with COLEMAN, FastCI reduces the median first-failure rank from 9 to 4 and the median GPU consumption before the first failure from 12.6 to 2.3 card-hours. It also performs better at P90 and P99 on both metrics. The two indicators provide complementary benefits. The instability indicator performs better at the median and P90, suggesting that recent test instability is more informative for most production failures. In contrast, the code change indicator performs better at P99, where CI runs tend to contain larger selected test sets. By combining both indicators, FastCI achieves better overall performance than either indicator alone.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate two questions: whether workload-optimized execution accelerates individual tests and whether this acceleration improves end-to-end CI. Comparing tests with and without workload optimization, we find that FastCI reduces average single-test execution time by 11.8% and GPU consumption by 19.3%, since tests with larger workloads tend to run longer and therefore offer more optimization opportunities. This acceleration of individual tests contributes to the end-to-end CI performance. As illustrated in Figure 5 , compared with FastCI-select, FastCI can further reduce the GPU resource usage by 18.3%, average CI latency by 28.6% and queueing time of tests by 46.6%, demonstrating the effectiveness of workload-optimized test execution in an end-to-end setting.

paragraphs.en: We study the sampling-rate tradeoff and whether runtime sampling overhead becomes a new CI bottleneck. We repeat the test selection evaluation in Section 5.2 at 10, 50, and 100 Hz, enabling context-aware pruning in all configurations. Thus, the reported recall and coverage reflect final selection rather than raw trace capture. In this evaluation, Hz denotes stack samples collected per second. Table 2 shows that higher rates provide more complete runtime evidence for coverage but add overhead. In practice, 50 Hz is a suitable tradeoff, retaining 99.2% of full-suite modified-code coverage with only 4.1% overhead. Raising the rate to 100 Hz improves retention by only 0.4% but raises overhead to 17.0%. paragraphs.en: We present FastCI, a framework that improves CI efficiency for LLM training frameworks by using a runtime evidence graph to select and prune tests while optimizing their scheduling and execution. paragraphs.en: Before selecting tests for an MR, FastCI loads the graph associated with its merge base, falling back to the stable graph if that version is unavailable, and saves it as the base snapshot for the current run. Each successfully traced test produces a partial graph. After the CI run, FastCI replaces the base snapshot’s evidence for these tests with their partial graphs, preserves evidence for tests not executed in the run, and stores the merged graph under the new commit. A later MR whose merge base matches that commit uses the updated graph for selection, and its execution produces the next set of traces, closing the collection–selection–update loop.

paragraphs.en: The LLM selection baseline operates on the same MR revisions and candidate tests as the other methods. We use the same instruction and repository-access scope for every evaluated MR. No execution outcome from the current or future MRs is provided.

paragraphs.en: To isolate the effect of test ordering, all schedulers receive the same selected tests, per-test runtime and GPU requirements, and MR order. COLEMAN treats each CI test as an arm and uses its FRRMAB scheduler with the TimeRank reward. Before each MR, FRRMAB combines the normalized TimeRank reward accumulated over a sliding window with an exploration bonus for less frequently observed tests. After the resulting order is replayed, TimeRank converts the test outcomes and their positions into rewards that favor placing failures earlier. We configure FRRMAB with C = 0.3 C=0.3 , a history window of 100 CI cycles, and a decay factor of 1, following the original evaluation ( Prado Lima & Vergilio, 2022 ) . Equal-score ties are broken using a seeded random order, and we average the results over ten fixed seeds. For each MR, COLEMAN produces the ranking using only outcomes from earlier MRs. The current MR’s outcomes are added to its history only after ranking and replay, preventing future-information leakage.
paragraphs.zh: 为了隔离测试排序的影响，所有调度器都接收相同的选定测试、每个测试的运行时间和 GPU 需求，以及 MR 顺序。 COLEMAN 将每个 CI 测试视为一个分支，并使用其 FRRMAB 调度器与 TimeRank 奖励相结合。 在每个 MR 之前，FRRMAB 会将滑动窗口中累积的归一化 TimeRank 奖励与较少观察到的测试所对应的探索奖励相结合。 在生成的顺序被重播后，TimeRank 会将测试结果及其位置转换为奖励，以优先安排失败测试更早执行。 我们按照原始评估（Prado Lima & Vergilio, 2022）的配置，将 FRRMAB 的 C 设为 0.3（C = 0.3），历史窗口设为 100 个 CI 周期，衰减因子设为 1。 分数相同时，使用带有固定种子的随机顺序进行破序，并对十个固定种子下的结果取平均值。 对于每个 MR，COLEMAN 仅使用先前 MR 的结果来生成排序。 当前 MR 的结果只有在完成排序和重播之后才会被添加到其历史中，从而防止未来信息的泄露。

paragraphs.en: The evaluation executes the complete CI test suite and collects per-job line coverage using Coverage.py . Coverage fragments within each job are combined before its XML report is exported. We retain positive-hit lines, normalize paths against the evaluated repository revision, and map them to executable lines inside Python function bodies, excluding module-level code, declarations, decorators, docstrings, comments, and blank lines. A test enters the offline affected-test reference for a modified function only if its report shows that execution entered the function body. Modified-code coverage retention is the fraction of executable lines in modified functions covered by the full CI suite that are also covered by the selected tests. A retention of 100% means that the selected tests execute every modified Python line covered by the full CI suite, but tests covering the same lines may exercise different inputs and assertions. The reference also excludes native C++ and CUDA execution.
paragraphs.zh: 评估会执行完整的 CI 测试套件，并使用 Coverage.py 收集每个任务的行覆盖情况。 每个任务内的覆盖片段会在导出其 XML 报告之前进行合并。 我们保留有效命中行，根据被评估的仓库版本对路径进行规范化处理，并将其映射到 Python 函数体内的可执行行，同时排除模块级代码、声明、装饰器、文档字符串、注释和空行。 只有当测试的报告显示其执行流程进入了修改后的函数体内时，该测试才会被纳入已修改函数的离线受影响测试参考中。 修改代码的覆盖保留率是指，在完整 CI 套件中被覆盖的修改函数内的可执行行中，同时也被所选测试所覆盖的比例。 100% 的保留率意味着所选测试执行了完整 CI 套件所覆盖的每一条被修改的 Python 代码行，但覆盖相同代码行的测试可能会使用不同的输入和断言。 该参考数据还排除了原生 C++ 和 CUDA 的执行。

paragraphs.en: We first implemented the complete FastCI workflow and exercised it end to end on the self-provisioned shadow CI used in our evaluation. This environment allowed us to validate the workflow and collect the experimental evidence without affecting production CI. We then reviewed the measured improvements and observed failure modes with the development team before enabling FastCI for production workload.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先实现了完整的 FastCI 工作流程，并在评估中使用的自配置影子 CI 上进行了端到端的测试。 这个环境使我们能够在不影响生产 CI 的情况下验证工作流程并收集实验证据。 随后，在启用 FastCI 处理生产工作负载之前，我们与开发团队一起审查了测得的性能提升并观察了故障模式。

sents.en: We first implemented the complete FastCI workflow and exercised it end to end on the self-provisioned shadow CI used in our evaluation.
sents.zh: 我们首先实现了完整的 FastCI 工作流程，并在评估中使用的自配置影子 CI 上进行了端到端的测试。

sents.en: This environment allowed us to validate the workflow and collect the experimental evidence without affecting production CI.
sents.zh: 这个环境使我们能够在不影响生产 CI 的情况下验证工作流程并收集实验证据。

sents.en: We then reviewed the measured improvements and observed failure modes with the development team before enabling FastCI for production workload.
sents.zh: 随后，在启用 FastCI 处理生产工作负载之前，我们与开发团队一起审查了测得的性能提升并观察了故障模式。

paragraphs.en: We rolled out FastCI in four stages. We first enabled runtime tracing for a small subset of CI tests to validate graph construction and maintenance. We then introduced an MR-title keyword that routed selected MRs through the complete FastCI workflow. Next, we expanded the set of instrumented tests to validate graph construction across the CI suite. After these checks, we removed the keyword gate and enabled FastCI by default for eligible production MRs.
paragraphs.zh: 我们以四个阶段推出了 FastCI。 我们首先为少量 CI 测试启用了运行时追踪，以验证图的构建与维护。 接着，我们引入一个 MR 标题关键词，将选定的 MR 引导至完整的 FastCI 工作流。 随后，我们扩大了已配置监控的测试集，以验证整个 CI 套件中的图构建过程。 完成这些检查后，我们移除了关键词限制，并默认对符合条件的生产 MR 启用 FastCI。

sents.en: We rolled out FastCI in four stages.
sents.zh: 我们以四个阶段推出了 FastCI。

sents.en: We first enabled runtime tracing for a small subset of CI tests to validate graph construction and maintenance.
sents.zh: 我们首先为少量 CI 测试启用了运行时追踪，以验证图的构建与维护。

sents.en: We then introduced an MR-title keyword that routed selected MRs through the complete FastCI workflow.
sents.zh: 接着，我们引入一个 MR 标题关键词，将选定的 MR 引导至完整的 FastCI 工作流。

sents.en: Next, we expanded the set of instrumented tests to validate graph construction across the CI suite.
sents.zh: 随后，我们扩大了已配置监控的测试集，以验证整个 CI 套件中的图构建过程。

sents.en: After these checks, we removed the keyword gate and enabled FastCI by default for eligible production MRs.
sents.zh: 完成这些检查后，我们移除了关键词限制，并默认对符合条件的生产 MR 启用 FastCI。

paragraphs.en: We maintained compatibility with the existing CI workflow throughout the rollout. For non-code configuration changes, such as YAML only updates, the test selection stage continued to use the existing CI rules rather than FastCI’s evidence guided test selection. The staged rollout allowed us to expand FastCI’s scope incrementally and validate each stage before proceeding.
paragraphs.zh: 在整个发布过程中，我们保持了与现有 CI 工作流的兼容性。 对于非代码类的配置变更（例如仅更新 YAML 文件），测试选择阶段仍继续使用原有的 CI 规则，而非 FastCI 基于证据的测试选择机制。 分阶段发布使我们能够逐步扩展 FastCI 的应用范围，并在推进到下一阶段前验证每个阶段的成果。

sents.en: We maintained compatibility with the existing CI workflow throughout the rollout.
sents.zh: 在整个发布过程中，我们保持了与现有 CI 工作流的兼容性。

sents.zh: 对于非代码类的配置变更（例如仅更新 YAML 文件），测试选择阶段仍继续使用原有的 CI 规则，而非 FastCI 基于证据的测试选择机制。

sents.zh: 分阶段发布使我们能够逐步扩展 FastCI 的应用范围，并在推进到下一阶段前验证每个阶段的成果。

paragraphs.en: To complement the staged rollout, we implemented a configuration-based rollback mechanism. A single configuration field supports two rollback levels: FastCI can stop handling incoming MRs, returning them to the existing CI workflow, or be disabled entirely. Both levels require only a configuration update, enabling rapid containment without code changes.
paragraphs.zh: 为了配合分阶段发布，我们实施了一种基于配置的回滚机制。 单个配置字段支持两种回滚级别：FastCI 可以停止处理传入的 MR，将其返回到现有的 CI 工作流，或者完全禁用。 这两种级别都只需更新配置，从而实现快速控制问题，而无需修改代码。

sents.en: To complement the staged rollout, we implemented a configuration-based rollback mechanism.
sents.zh: 为了配合分阶段发布，我们实施了一种基于配置的回滚机制。

sents.en: A single configuration field supports two rollback levels: FastCI can stop handling incoming MRs, returning them to the existing CI workflow, or be disabled entirely.
sents.zh: 单个配置字段支持两种回滚级别：FastCI 可以停止处理传入的 MR，将其返回到现有的 CI 工作流，或者完全禁用。

sents.en: Both levels require only a configuration update, enabling rapid containment without code changes.
sents.zh: 这两种级别都只需更新配置，从而实现快速控制问题，而无需修改代码。

paragraphs.en: During early validation, only a small number of traces had accumulated, and graph maintenance appeared inexpensive. Our initial implementation eagerly processed all accumulated traces and maintained graphs for every version. In production, however, the amount of trace processing performed for each MR grew as traces accumulated, eventually causing the test-selection step to time out. We therefore switched to on-demand graph materialization. For each MR, FastCI processes only the traces associated with the version whose graph is required. This makes the trace-processing overhead per MR O ⁡ ( 1 ) O(1) with respect to the total number of accumulated traces.
paragraphs.zh: 在早期验证阶段，仅积累了少量轨迹，且图维护的成本似乎很低。 我们的初始实现会急切地处理所有已积累的轨迹，并为每个版本维护图结构。 然而在生产环境中，随着轨迹的积累，每个 MR 所执行的轨迹处理量逐渐增加，最终导致测试选择步骤超时。 因此，我们转而采用按需图构建的方式。 对于每个 MR，FastCI 仅处理与所需版本对应的轨迹。 这使得每个 MR 的轨迹处理开销相对于已积累轨迹的总数而言为 O(1)。

paragraphs.en: FastCI requires a small set of test-specific settings for each CI test run. Our initial design centrally managed these settings in persistent storage, requiring each test to perform remote reads and writes during execution. Across many concurrently running tests, this remote I/O introduced considerable overhead. We therefore pass the necessary inputs through environment variables and let each test derive its settings locally. This removes remote storage access from the test execution path and nearly eliminates the configuration overhead.
paragraphs.zh: FastCI 每次 CI 测试运行仅需一组与测试相关的设置。 我们的初始设计将这些设置集中管理在持久化存储中，导致每次测试在执行期间都需要进行远程读写操作。 对于大量并发运行的测试而言，这种远程 I/O 带来了显著的性能开销。 因此，我们通过环境变量传递必要的输入参数，并让每个测试本地推导出其所需设置。 这样既将远程存储访问从测试执行流程中移除，也几乎消除了配置带来的性能开销。

sents.zh: FastCI 每次 CI 测试运行仅需一组与测试相关的设置。

sents.en: Our initial design centrally managed these settings in persistent storage, requiring each test to perform remote reads and writes during execution.
sents.zh: 我们的初始设计将这些设置集中管理在持久化存储中，导致每次测试在执行期间都需要进行远程读写操作。

sents.en: Across many concurrently running tests, this remote I/O introduced considerable overhead.
sents.zh: 对于大量并发运行的测试而言，这种远程 I/O 带来了显著的性能开销。

sents.en: We therefore pass the necessary inputs through environment variables and let each test derive its settings locally.
sents.zh: 因此，我们通过环境变量传递必要的输入参数，并让每个测试本地推导出其所需设置。

sents.en: This removes remote storage access from the test execution path and nearly eliminates the configuration overhead.
sents.zh: 这样既将远程存储访问从测试执行流程中移除，也几乎消除了配置带来的性能开销。
